title: Q&A with New York Assembly member and ex-Palantir staffer Alex Bores on running for Congress, Palantir, opposition from super PAC Leading the Future, and more (Katie Drummond/Wired)
summary: Katie Drummond / Wired: Q&A with New York Assembly member and ex-Palantir staffer Alex Bores on running for Congress, Palantir, opposition from super PAC Leading the Future, and more — Alex Bores, a former Palantir employee, helped pass one of the country's toughest AI laws. Now Silicon Valley's biggest names are trying to stop his rise to Congress.
